# addlink M.2 PCIe NVMe SSDs

Compare addlink PCIe Gen3, Gen4 and Gen5 NVMe SSDs with sequential read speeds up to 10,300 MB/s and capacities up to 8TB. Choose from M.2 2230 and 2280 models, with or without heatsinks, to match your device’s requirements.​

## With Heatsink

G55H Gen5x4

Up to 10,300MB/s

A85 Gen4x4

Up to 6,000MB/s

A95 Gen4x4

Up to 7,200MB/s

A93 Gen4x4

Up to 7,400MB/s

...

### With Heatsink

| Model | Form Factor | Max. Sequential Read | Capacity | Ideal For |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| G55H Gen5x4 | M.2 2280 | Up to 10,300MB/s | 1TB,2TB,4TB | AI Workloads,Heavy Workloads,Gaming,4K/8K Video Editing |
| A95 Gen4x4 | M.2 2280 | Up to 7,200MB/s | 1TB,2TB,4TB,8TB | Heavy Workloads,Gaming,4K/8K Video Editing,Content Editing |
| A93 Gen4x4 | M.2 2280 | Up to 7,400MB/s | 1TB,2TB,4TB | Heavy Workloads,Gaming,4K/8K Video Editing,Content Editing |
| A85 Gen4x4 | M.2 2280 | Up to 6,000MB/s | 512GB,1TB,2TB | Gaming,Content Editing,Budget-friendly |

...

Choose Gen3 for everyday upgrades, Gen4 for gaming and content creation, or Gen5 for demanding workloads on compatible PCs. Select a heatsink model where space allows, or use your device’s cooling solution. Match the SSD size to your device: S91 (M.2 2230) for the original ROG Ally; S93 (M.2 2280) matches the ROG Ally X form factor. Check device requirements before installation.

* Performance figures are based on addlink internal testing using specific hardware and configurations. Actual speed may vary by host system, workload, SSD capacity, operating system, and firmware.

## Troubleshooting tips

If your PS5 does not detect or recognize you SSD, please check these things first.

1. Check your SSD SPEC, if Your SSD is M.2 NVMe Gen4x4 SSD. 2. Please make sure you fully plugged it hard to the expansion connector

3. Please check if your PS5 with the latest firmware

• Please make sure your software have been updated to the latest version (system software version 21.02-04 or higher). 

You can go to Settings > System > System Software > System Software Update and Settings > Update System Software.

With remarkable read speeds of up to 7.2 GB/s, the S95 SSD designed empower professionals to optimize the workflows, eliminating rendering delays for audio and video tasks. By Combining four S95 8TB with a RAID card, you can create 32TB storage array for Mac Pro or AMD Threadripper workstations, it can delver speeds of up to 14GB/s and 28GB/s, respectively. This solution is ideal for creators, and AI Applications, offering unmatched performance and eliminating any storage limitations you may have faced before.
